Unit handling: none — the component renders version strings + a formatted timestamp only; no SI/imperial conversion surface. API path: none directly (the parent feeds current/latest/checkedAt from /system/update-check); the only URL is the static GitHub release-notes href, preserved verbatim.

No DOM modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, or old web UI components are imported; only React, react-native (Linking/Pressable/StyleSheet/View), the native AppText + GlassPanel primitives, and the spacing token are used. State names (none — pure props component), visual intent (cyan callout), and behaviour (open release notes) are preserved.
Gates: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit), `npm run lint -- --quiet`, and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` all run; commit scoped to apps/native only.
